homepage.headline: A designer who thinks in systems, sweats the right details, and considers what comes next.
homepage.sub: Currently building partner discovery, universal search, and AI-assisted experiences for SAP's global platform.

paragraphs: Hi! I'm Elaine Shih, a product designer based in NYC. I work on SAP's Business Network — partner discovery, universal search, and AI-assisted experiences built for companies operating at global scale.
As an organize-holic, I take pride in keeping layers and files categorized, bringing this habit from life to work. I sweat the right details — and I know when to stop.

Before diving into the product field, I started in graphic design, specialized in identity systems, and spent more than a few weeks on a single logotype (no regrets). That foundation is in everything I do — I think about how things look because I think about how they read.
I also run Prompt Party — a community for designers getting curious about AI. (This portfolio was built with Claude. Make of that what you will.)

You'll find me building Spotify playlists 24/7 with a variety of genres, enjoying scenic nature, savoring time in the kitchen, collecting washi tapes & Blackwing pencils as a stationery nerd, arms up high in the first row of a rollercoaster, and eating lemons like how you eat tangerines.
